concepts.title: Stars and Constellations
concepts.definition: The night sky glitters with countless stars, suns of great distances; long ago people joined bright stars into patterns called constellations, naming them after hunters, bears and heroes to map the sky.
concepts.key_idea: Constellations are sky-signposts: remembered patterns that help us find our way among the stars.

name some constellations visible in the night sky
why did people name patterns of stars
how can you find the pole star
why do stars appear to move across the night sky
draw the constellation you found in the sky

concepts.title: Watching the Night Sky
concepts.definition: Sky watching needs only dark, clear nights and patience: go away from city lights, let eyes adjust, find patterns with the help of star charts, and record what you see each night.
concepts.key_idea: Astronomy begins at home: regular watching turns the sky from noise into a map you can read.
question_patterns: how should we prepare for night sky watching
why are stars better seen away from city lights
record the positions of stars over a few hours
how does the night sky change with seasons
which star does not appear to move at night
make your own sky watching diary

concepts.title: Our Solar System
concepts.definition: The sun sits at the centre of our solar system with eight planets circling it, Mercury to Neptune, joined by moons, asteroids and comets; earth is the third planet, the one known to hold life.
concepts.formula: solar system = sun + 8 planets + moons + asteroids + comets
concepts.key_idea: One star, many worlds: the sun's gravity holds every planet in its appointed path.
question_patterns: name the planets in order from the sun

concepts.title: The Milky Way and the Universe
concepts.definition: Our sun is one star among billions gathered in the Milky Way galaxy, a band of light across the night sky; and the Milky Way itself is one galaxy among countless others, all together forming the universe.
concepts.key_idea: Scale upon scale: earth to solar system to galaxy to universe, each step beyond imagining, yet all real.
